betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Got more items than you know what to do with? The §6Matter Condenser §fturns excess into something useful.

It has three modes: §6Trash §f(delete items), §6Matter Balls §f(256 items into 1 Matter Ball), and §6Singularity §f(256,000 items into 1 Singularity). Singularities are the most compressed storage form in AE2.

Place a Storage Component in the bottom slot to increase internal storage capacity. The condenser needs power to operate and consumes AE/t while processing.

Craft it from Iron, Quartz Glass, and Fluix Dust. Check JEI for the exact pattern.

§cWARNING:§f Do not accidentally set it to Trash mode when you meant Singularity. Those items are gone.

§ePS:§f Connect an Import Bus to feed the Condenser and an Export Bus to extract the output.
